title: Catalog Onramp — Launch Conductor Handbook for New Model Releases
creator: Asha Mehta
description: A concise, prescriptive handbook for the Launch Conductor responsible for coordinating cross-team activity when adding a new model to the Redwood catalog. This ticket captures the canonical checklist, communications schedule, artifact owners, and early risk triggers (privacy/compliance, performance regressions, capacity). The goal: reduce last-mile friction and ensure reproducible handoffs between PM, Eng, Design, and GTM teams.
acceptance_criteria: Owner (Launch Conductor) assigned and comms calendar created
Benchmark results published to catalog page and internal dashboard with stable baseline and variance notes
Release notes draft reviewed by Eng/Design/Legal and approved for publication
SDK/REST compatibility matrix validated against latest API contract
Support runbook + incident FAQs deployed to internal docs and linked from catalog entry
Rollout gating conditions (latency, error rate, cost) defined and observable in Console dashboards
rollout_steps: Week -3: Intake review — confirm model artifact, license, and initial benchmark plan
Week -2: Benchmarks and prompt set run — publish raw results to /drive and tag with run-id
Week -2: Design provides hero examples, safety guidance, and UX copy for catalog card
Week -1: Draft release notes and customer-facing docs; legal/security review for PII/KMS impacts
T-3 days: SDK samples updated, quickstart repo PR opened and linked to this ticket
T-2 days: Internal preview email to beta customers and SEs with opt-in links
Launch day: Publish catalog entry, release notes, announce on status channels and blog
Post-launch Day 0-7: Monitor metrics; if any gating threshold breached trigger rollback/fallback per policy
release_notes_summary: Adds <model-name> to the catalog: improved long-form reasoning and 2x cheaper embeddings in quantized configs. Includes example prompts, API samples, and known limitations (tokenization differences, hallucination modes). See expanded notes linked in artifacts.
risks_mitigations: Risk: Benchmark variance on long-tail prompts could delay launch — Mitigation: add confidence intervals and mark as 'beta' in catalog
Risk: Model licensing clause requires attribution — Mitigation: legal approved copy and license snippet included in release notes
Risk: Increased p99 latency under heavy burst — Mitigation: dedicated autoscale policy staged for first 72h and traffic shaping to fallback model
Risk: SDK compatibility break for older clients — Mitigation: add deprecation header and maintain compatibility shim for one release
